NON-BOOT SCAN SET — derived live at 5710 build (F1)
====================================================
source: BOOT_SEQUENCE.md (the mandatory boot manifest) — path tokens +
wildcard-directory expansion + floor {BOOT_SEQUENCE.md, docs/.readme,
cue/CUE_INDEX.md, README.md}. Scan hits (any boot-graph file referencing
catalogs/model_research) are build failures via check 41.
Language law: "scan", never "asserted", until the full transitive boot graph
is provably covered.

5710 ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA — 6/6 (captured live)
===============================================
1. non-boot test rejects docs/.readme + every canonical boot-manifest path .... vector 20 + derived-scan floor
2. spoofed tiers / impossible dates / stale reviews / blank-undated registers . vectors 8, 11, 13, 16, 17, 18
3. unverified identifiers cannot masquerade as exact ids ..................... vectors 14, 15, 19 (if/then + filename binding)
4. 5600 recursion + registry reference/test-binding fixed, permanent tests ... relay vector 24; registry vectors 14, 15 (R6/R7/R8)
5. roadmap placement / schema path / date convention / counts match reality .. F5 batch (measured: 25 tests, 22 tools, 38-vector cp)
6. validator, unit suite, catalog self-test, relay, CAP, PASS, cp, strict, whitespace, CI pass at the new SHA ... sealed-tree proof + Commander's push
